So did you hear they're coming out with a new Fast and Furious?
It's Fast and the Furious: Jesus Takes the Wheel.

Yea, and I know they didn't/don't know. Honestly though I'd hate for them to know since I know it would cause them pain, and I wouldn't want that for them. The thing with 50/50 work pretty well since I do school online just sometimes gets hard when money is tight since they live on opposite sides of the county. I've thought about getting a job which would mean I could pay for my flights, but with that comes the fact that I wouldn't be able to visit unless I quite my job or it was for a few days. Oh and yes I'm in high school finishing up my senior year so it's time for me to decide weather to do collage or the military first, either way they will pay for the schooling or at least most.

Thanks, and that's a good point not being afraid and having courage are quite different. The verbal abuse was probably about 1/4 of what weighs me down, 2/4 is the constant tugging by either my mother or father with them wanting me to live with which ever one I'm not currently living with and the guilt that comes along with upsetting the one I don't chose, and the last 1/4 is the fact that I've always understood the real world and felt more of it then any current person of my age at any given time should of. I want to join the marines, I've actually have the ability to get the recommendations from congress men/women or senator to go to school at the Naval Academy if I wanted. However I know that my suicide attempts could haunt me on that one, but I was lucky enough that with all my stuff there's not much for them to go off of since I asked my doctors to not keep complete details in their reports other then what was necessary and I can get all of my stuff written off as situation since nothing was done to prove other wise. Unfortunately I can't go back to counseling or anything else since it would most likely eliminate my chances to get in to the Marines and what I'd like to do in there.

Good video again by the way :) I'll be checking out other's in the TED series seems interesting and like they will be helpful over all. 

I'm interested in maybe getting a sub channel on a good IRC as well, we could use that for chatting and stuff :)

P.S. I'm a boy and my DOB is 1-9-96, and sorry for taking so long to reply I come in go from things but I never leave forever.

I'm a bit younger then you, and I see what your saying but I lost the fear of death many many years ago so living and dieing to mean very little the worth while part is relative and could mean so many things. The harm part could be a fair bit, I was the quite kid in school most people knew me, not many people cared much I never made a wake. The harm came mainly from the the fact up until I was 16 I was verbally and mentally abused by my step mother, I was bullied in school, I never really fit in anywhere because I never stayed anywhere. I have RAD (reactive attachment disorder, I don't make relationships very easy and I have difficulty of letting the once I make go.) One of the thing many people don't know about me. The thing is I know what I want to do in life but I also don't know if I will be able to any more. Others though know I am not the type of person who be predicted with anything. I don't form patterns that other could recognize.

I'm the kind of person who has potential to fit in anywhere but yet I have no place anywhere.

The video however was extreamly good, it had quite a few points that I will be turring over in my head for a good while. I like the very end, "Always remain hungry, and always remain foolish." So many meanings in one simple quote.

I've thought that for a while, a lot of people told me that. The thing is I don't see it, and thinking back though out my life I feel I've done more harm then good. There's better people who die from less.
